claims.claim: On November 25, 2026, Rayath Chowdhury filed a proposed class action in the US District Court for the Southern District of New York against Gemini and the Winklevoss twins over sports prediction markets.
claims.episode_span: filed a proposed nationwide class action on November 25, 2026, in the US District Court for the Southern District of New York
claims.source_title: Gemini, Winklevoss Twins Sued Over Sports Prediction Markets
claims.supporting_quote: The complaint , filed on November 25 in the US District Court for the Southern District of New York, seeks recovery of customer losses, damages and injunctive relief.

claims.claim: The complaint names Gemini Space Station, Gemini Titan, Gemini Olympus, Winklevoss Capital Fund, and Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss.
claims.episode_span: naming Gemini Space Station, Gemini Titan, Gemini Olympus, Winklevoss Capital Fund, and cofounders Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss
claims.source_title: Gemini, Winklevoss Twins Sued Over Sports Prediction Markets
claims.supporting_quote: The lawsuit names Gemini Space Station, Gemini Titan, Gemini Olympus, Winklevoss Capital Fund and both Winklevoss brothers as defendants.

claims.claim: US appeals courts remain divided over whether federal oversight preempts state gambling laws for these contracts.
claims.episode_span: US appeals courts remain divided over whether federal oversight of these contracts preempts state gambling laws
claims.source_title: Gemini, Winklevoss Twins Sued Over Sports Prediction Markets
claims.supporting_quote: Gemini operates its prediction market through federally regulated subsidiaries, but US appeals courts remain divided over whether federal oversight preempts state gambling laws.

claims.claim: Chowdhury alleges Gemini is disguising sports betting as financial trading in violation of state gambling laws, and New York requires a license for mobile sports wagering.
claims.episode_span: disguises sports betting as financial trading in violation of state gambling laws — New York requires a license for mobile sports wagering
claims.source_title: Winklevoss Twins, Gemini Sued Over Sports Prediction Markets
claims.supporting_quote: New York-based Gemini, its entities, and Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss are disguising sports betting as financial trading in violation of state gambling laws, bettor Rayath Chowdhury told the US District Court for the Southern District of New York.

claims.claim: Chowdhury alleges he began losing money on Gemini Predictions sports contracts in May 2026, and the amount in controversy is alleged to exceed $5 million.
claims.episode_span: began losing money on Gemini Predictions sports contracts in May 2026
claims.source_title: Gemini, Winklevoss Twins Sued Over Sports Prediction Markets
claims.supporting_quote: Plaintiff Rayath Chowdhury alleges that he began losing money on sports event contracts through Gemini Predictions in May 2026.

claims.claim: Gemini launched its prediction market in December 2025 and began offering College Football Playoff and NFL Wild Card contracts on January 8, 2026, later adding other sports and combos.
claims.episode_span: launched in December 2025, added College Football Playoff and NFL Wild Card contracts on January 8, 2026
claims.source_title: Gemini, Winklevoss Twins Sued Over Sports Prediction Markets
claims.supporting_quote: Gemini launched its prediction market in December 2025 and began offering contracts on College Football Playoff and NFL Wild Card games on January 8, 2026.

claims.claim: The complaint cites a market on whether the New York Mets would win by more than 1.5 runs and describes a taker-rate fee as a 7 percent rake.
claims.episode_span: whether the New York Mets would win by more than 1.5 runs
claims.source_title: Gemini, Winklevoss Twins Sued Over Sports Prediction Markets
claims.supporting_quote: The complaint cites, for example, a market on whether the New York Mets would win a game by more than 1.5 runs.

claims.claim: The complaint says users can fund wagers with crypto in Gemini accounts without licensed New York sportsbook deposit limits, and that Gemini wins every time its customers bet.
claims.episode_span: wins every time its customers bet
claims.source_title: Gemini, Winklevoss Twins Sued Over Sports Prediction Markets
claims.supporting_quote: Gemini, according to the complaint, “wins every time its customers bet.”

claims.claim: The complaint says Winklevoss Capital Fund holds all Class B shares and about 94 percent of voting power, and in May bought $100 million of Gemini stock paid in about 1,258 bitcoin.
claims.episode_span: holds all Class B shares and about 94 percent of voting power
claims.source_title: Gemini, Winklevoss Twins Sued Over Sports Prediction Markets
claims.supporting_quote: It argues that the twins control Gemini through Winklevoss Capital Fund, which holds all of Gemini’s Class B shares and about 94% of its voting power.

claims.claim: The complaint quotes Tyler Winklevoss on a February 8 post and Cameron Winklevoss on the size of prediction markets.
claims.episode_span: placed my Super Bowl prediction on the @Gemini app
claims.source_title: Gemini, Winklevoss Twins Sued Over Sports Prediction Markets
claims.supporting_quote: It quotes a February 8 post in which Tyler Winklevoss wrote that he had “placed my Super Bowl prediction on the @Gemini app.”

claims.claim: The complaint says Gemini accepts bets from 18- to 20-year-olds although New York requires sports bettors to be at least 21, and cites a February 25 St. John's-UConn market.
claims.episode_span: accepts bets from 18- to 20-year-olds although New York requires sports bettors to be at least 21
claims.source_title: Gemini, Winklevoss Twins Sued Over Sports Prediction Markets
claims.supporting_quote: It says Gemini accepts bets from 18- to 20-year-olds, although New York requires sports bettors to be at least 21.

claims.claim: In 2024 Gemini agreed to return more than $1 billion to Gemini Earn customers and pay a $37 million fine; in January 2025 a court ordered a $5 million CFTC penalty; in October 2026 a judge refused to vacate that order.
claims.episode_span: in 2024 Gemini agreed to return more than $1 billion to Gemini Earn customers and pay a $37 million fine
claims.source_title: Gemini, Winklevoss Twins Sued Over Sports Prediction Markets
claims.supporting_quote: In 2024, Gemini agreed to return more than $1 billion to customers of its Gemini Earn crypto lending program and pay a $37 million fine to New York’s financial regulator.

claims.claim: Chainalysis found Western European traders put 74 percent of US-Iran prediction-market buy volume on negative outcomes versus 49 percent elsewhere, and lost 0.8 percent while others gained 2.4 percent.

claims.claim: On de-escalation markets Western Europe allocated 86 percent of buy volume to No versus 61 percent elsewhere, losing 1.2 percent while others gained 3 percent.

claims.claim: Western Europe lost 1.2 percent on regime and nuclear markets while others gained 2.2 percent, and allocated 52 percent of buy volume to affirmative outcomes versus 30 percent elsewhere.

claims.source_title: Western Europe Loses on US-Iran Prediction Markets as 74% Bet on Bad Outcomes

claims.claim: Western Europe's cryptocurrency economy reached $2.08 trillion from July 2025 through June 2026, and ESMA on July 3 said event contracts that are financial instruments fall under binary-option restrictions for retail customers.
claims.episode_span: puts Western Europe's cryptocurrency economy at $2.08 trillion in on-chain value from July 2025 through June 2026

claims.supporting_quote: The findings form part of Chainalysis’s 2026 Geography of Cryptocurrency Report , which placed Western Europe’s cryptocurrency economy at $2.08 trillion between July 2025 and June 2026, making it the second-largest globally.
